rationale: JLS: an interface extends ALL interfaces in its extends clause; interfaces never implement. Grammar: interface_declaration > extends_interfaces > type_list holds every parent. JAD3 (M37 java wave): the implicit-public interface method fetch is pinned as an EXPORT — the pre-fix exports filter (ownerKind === Class only, visibility=undefined for unmodified interface members) silently excluded the most intentional API surface in Java. M49 JVM-closure exports ruling: exports are importable units — the interface type Repository is the export; member fetch rides Contains. (JAD3 member half reversed, probe-pinned: bare member names cannot identify their provider across overloads.)
